items.stem: For a VAT-registered trading business, VAT charged to customers (output VAT) is best described as:

options.text: Collected on behalf of the tax authority and owed onward, net of input VAT
options.rationale: Correct: output VAT is collected for the authority, offset by recoverable input VAT.

options.text: Additional sales revenue for the business
options.rationale: VAT collected is not the business's revenue.

options.text: A permanent cost the business cannot recover
options.rationale: Registered businesses offset input VAT, so it flows through.

options.text: Irrelevant once the invoice is raised
options.rationale: Output VAT must be reported and remitted.

items.explanation: Correct: output VAT is collected for the authority, offset by recoverable input VAT.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO controls improve the accuracy of VAT reporting? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Validating VAT codes on supplier and customer master data
options.rationale: Correct: correct coding at source prevents misstatement.

options.text: Reconciling the VAT control account to the return before filing
options.rationale: Correct: reconciliation catches errors before submission.

options.text: Guessing the VAT rate when unsure to save time
options.rationale: Guessing rates causes misstatement and penalties.
Omitting transactions understates VAT and breaks records.

items.explanation: Correct: correct coding at source prevents misstatement.

items.stem: A zero-rated supply differs from an exempt supply because, for a zero-rated supply, the business:

options.text: Charges VAT at 0% and can generally still recover related input VAT
options.rationale: Correct: zero-rated supplies allow input VAT recovery; exempt supplies generally do not.

options.text: Cannot recover any input VAT at all
options.rationale: That is the usual position for exempt, not zero-rated, supplies.
Zero-rated means a 0% rate, not the standard rate.

options.text: Is always outside the VAT system
options.rationale: Zero-rated supplies are within the VAT system at 0%.

items.explanation: Correct: zero-rated supplies allow input VAT recovery; exempt supplies generally do not.
